title: Pornhub's parent company, Aylo, will pay $120M to settle two 2021 class action lawsuits in California and Alabama alleging it profited from child abuse material (Samantha Cole/404 Media)
summary: Samantha Cole / 404 Media: Pornhub's parent company, Aylo, will pay $120M to settle two 2021 class action lawsuits in California and Alabama alleging it profited from child abuse material — The deal settles class action lawsuits claiming Mindgeek's sites hosted and profited from abuse videos of minors.
